Home.headline: Live Note Taker — realtime lecture notes, built for students in Southeast Asia.
Home.subBefore: A memorable name and a clear demo: speak into the mic → transcript updates live (dev via VALSEA RTT). Solid stack: TypeScript, Supabase, and a
Home.subAfter: folder so your team and Cursor share one map.
Home.cardFrontendBody: App Router with Server Components by default; Client Components only when needed. cn() utility for predictable Tailwind classes.
Home.cardBackendBody: Supabase (Postgres + Auth). Separate server and browser clients; middleware refreshes the session cookie.
